subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

In the fast lane
solution:
The correct answer is **"In great excitement."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"In the fast lane"** is an idiom that means to be moving quickly and with great energy, in a way that is exciting and slightly dangerous. (तेजी से और बड़ी ऊर्जा के साथ आगे बढ़ना, एक तरह से जो रोमांचक और थोड़ा खतरनाक हो)

 
 
• **Example**: *He lived life **in the fast lane**__ when he was young.*
 
 
 
• **"In the fast lane"** means **"In great excitement."**
 
• The correct answer is option 1.
